notes.title: Patchnotes Update 2.4.0c
notes.content:
[h2][b]Patchnotes Update 2.4.0c[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Today, we released version 2.4.0c of Florensia, which addresses some issues and introduces some new quality of life improvements as well as one experimental change that we would like to test together with the community.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Experimental Defence Change[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]As some of you know, having too much defence in the game results in some cases where players don't get a lot of damage in PvP. We noticed that a lot during the last PvP League, as well as in recent feedback.[/p][p]We don't want to change how defence works in PvE (so that you guys can continue to tank everything you were already able to tank), but we don't think that the way defence scales for PvP is enjoyable at the moment.[/p][p][b]With this patch, we adjusted some things which will result in players' defences being 20% less effective in player vs player combat.[/b] Your defences are still 100% effective against monsters.[/p][p]Internally, we conducted extensive testing and settled on 20% for both physical and magical defence.[/p][p]As initially stated, this is an experimental change. We will have a feedback thread pinned in Discord. We'd love to hear what you guys think of this change.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Increased movement speed for lootpets (this does not include combat pets).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the sea exp death penalty to match the one on land (0.15%). You will only start to lose exp above level 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Blood Thirst to properly check distance when pulling monsters and players[/p][/*][*][p]Lightning Recall is now of type "Physical" instead of "Lightning", which results in the skill now properly using physical hitrate instead of magical.[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional client and version checks[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Fixed Vampiric Touch not healing when the skill is used to kill a monster or player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed HP / MP recovery incorrectly when sitting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed not being able to cast skills / heals when a dead target is selected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some skills being cancelled if the target died during casting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Hide (sea skill) still being active when going to land[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error in the exp calculation that did not properly account for players +-15 level out of range, which should have reduced the amount of exp instead of multiplying it.
In most cases, this should not result in getting less experience if the level of your party was close together.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various typos in skill descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Possible fix for a bug on sea that would stop you from steering.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patchnotes Update 2.4.0b
notes.content: [h2][b]Patchnotes Update 2.4.0b[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][/p][p]Today we released version 2.4.0b of Florensia, which addresses a few remaining issues and introduces some new quality of life.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Adjusted several values for Kommandant Humbert Unruh. We will continue to monitor feedback and adjust values where needed.[/p][list][*][p]Physical defence: [strike]3200[/strike] -> 2500[/p][/*][*][p]Magical defence: [strike]3200[/strike] -> 2500[/p][/*][*][p]Avoidance rate: [strike]900[/strike] -> 500[/p][/*][*][p]All elemental defences: [strike]1100[/strike] -> 600[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a cooldown of 3 minutes (180 seconds) to the Medicinal herb of Revival.[/p][/*][*][p]All combat pets are no longer able to attack other players with skills. Auto-attacks are still possible, which is intended. This change was made to mitigate abuse and avoid several balancing issues caused by pets ignoring the defence. We will keep investigating alternatives, however we believe that this is the correct approach going forward as it creates a more even playing field. [/p][/*][*][p]Changed some defaults for settings:[/p][list][*][p]Shadows: Detailed[/p][/*][*][p]BGM sound: Changed from 50% down to 30%[/p][/*][*][p]Refuse Party: Now turned [b]off [/b]by default[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]All Tower Party quests can now be handed in to the Roxbury Tower Manager. The quest shells can still be obtained by any Tower Manager on all islands.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional enhancements to the multi-client prevention system.[/p][/*][*][p]Added thousands separator to several locations where Gelt is displayed, this includes but is not limited to the trading window and inventory.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Fixed wrong health values for several monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wrong naming of Woodywoody essences to match the name of the monster: WoodyWoody. Uppercases matter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various NPC names.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various monster names. The names of monsters across all languages have now been standardized to the English naming.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wrong description of debuff from "\[Elite]Corrupted Maid". The debuff reduces Magic min. and max. attack by 350 and decreases HP and MP by 2000.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue whereby a player would be slowed down, if they were buffed while having Ice Shield active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed one of the quest markers for "Valuable Medical Stuff" (level 33) being outside the map. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed in-client "Register" button redirecting to wrong page on the homepage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sea ability "Ship Recovery" healing more than mentioned in the description. The values have now been adjusted to match the description.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed partially wrong description for sea ability "Randomly Shooting". All descriptions have been changed to English for the time being with the only exception being German. We will provide updated translations at a later date.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed healed values for several abilities not matching their descriptions. The affected abilities are: Healing Hands, Instant Recovery, Master Recovery and Aurora of Life.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that allowed for an indefinite amount of teleportations to a players' partner using the marriage system.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed regression in login system that caused password input content to not be detected correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed massive FPS drops in main menu caused by grass & tree nodes not being culled properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual glitch causing artifacts in world selection screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a variety of text alignments/visibility issues in UIs, including but not limited to login, character selection, character creation, in-game UI, world map, trade window, and inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo with trade Gelt limit amount in chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes various crashes and performance issues[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Note | Update 2.4
notes.content:
[h3][b]Welcome to update 2.4.0![/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p]We're very excited to finally bring update 2.4.0 to you - our very first in-house developed update! Like the takeover for Florensia earlier this year, this marks yet another massive milestone on our journey and we're excited to finally be able to share it with you. [/p][p]A lot has been going on in the past few months. We have worked tirelessly to not only understand the code but also to organize everything, clean up a lot of the codebase, create new tools that will aid us in development, create processes for more seamless and faster updates and so much more. There is still a lot of work ahead of us but we hope that you will enjoy this first update as much as we did working on it.[/p][p]With this patch now going live, we are also opening a feedback / ideas forum in Discord where we are eagerly awaiting your suggestions on how to improve the game. You can find the forum thread [url="https://discord.com/channels/534732272553689109/1366467440225157241"]here[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25229855/d1797afeb283f3e2226918399c9d21e9552afee5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Temporary changes[/h3][hr][/hr][list][*][p]As we are currently investigating crashes caused by using the "high" texture quality, we have decided to temporarily disable this option. After installing the game, the "low" quality will be set by default without the option of changing it for the time being. Once the investigation has been completed, we will of course turn the option back on. The "low" option uses the old "high" textures from before the HD textures update.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]New[/h3][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Initial implementation of [b]Easy Anti-Cheat[/b]. This is a big step towards making the game a safer and more enjoyable environment for everyone. With this addition however, come a few notable changes: [/p][list][*][p]Virtual machines are no longer supported and the game will close automatically when it is run inside one.[/p][/*][*][p]Sandboxie will now cause the game to close immediately.[/p][/*][*][p]Easy Anti-Cheat support for Linux has been enabled, making it still playable under Linux environments (not officially supported).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added an option in settings to enable or disable chat notifications about experience gained by your companion (pet). They will however still add a penalty to the overall gained experience. [/p][/*][*][p]Players who are +/- 15 levels of the [u]slain monster[/u] do not add any benefits towards the experience distribution. notes.title: Status Update about first upcoming changes
notes.content:
Hello,

We have a few things to share today!

First things first: Our new lead developer is going through a lot of different things in regards to the code. While doing so, he is also writing a lot of documentation that is desperately needed. In the meantime, he has also cleaned up a lot of leftovers that are no longer used. 
Right now, the focus is on getting the patching system done and establishing an
automated build & shipping process, so that we can deliver updates faster and more efficiently in the future. 

While we cannot give any timeline at the moment, what we can do is tell you what we have planned for the first patch (so it still can change). But before doing so, please keep in mind that we will start small and work our way up to bigger, more exciting updates.

**Patch verification system:**
This system will verify that the client is on the latest patch. This will allow us to make sure everyone is on the latest version and mitigate potential issues caused by bypassing the launcher. 

**Anti cheat**
While our coder was working on cleaning unused, old code and deleting about a dozen of old and often never used Anti Cheat tools, he started working on the integration of a new anti cheat solution. This has progressed better than we ever anticipated and we are confident that we will be able to deliver this within our first patch. For this, we will be using the well known and well established Easy Anti Cheat solution. 
It goes without saying that this is a huge milestone which will aid us in the fight against bots and cheaters alike. 

With this however, come a few changes.
Namely the fact that Sandboxie will no longer be usable. We are aware of potential negative side effects this may have on some of you, such as no longer being able to trade between two characters on different accounts. We are actively working on finding solutions to this, as well as other quality of life issues. 

This change will also require a fresh installation, for which we will provide an updated installer. We will of course inform you once again when we arrive at this point.

**Quality of life changes:**
- We will fix/remove the "You can't act while moving" spam appearing both on screen and in the chat log.
- Experience points gained by the pet will be toggleable in the settings, so that you can decide whether or not you want to see it. 

On first glance, these changes may not seem like a big step but it is important preparation work that we must take to ensure we can work on a solid foundation. As we are still
getting to understand the code, priorities may change depending on how easy or difficult certain things turn out to be. 

As for what comes after that, we are currently planning a lot of exciting things, many of which we cannot share just yet. But to give you a glimpse, here are some things:

- **HOW:** We are looking into activating HOW on the test server to see whether or not we can fix the known issues and potentially bring this feature back online.
- **ED4:** Most of the concept for this was already done when AHA was still developing Florensia. We even had it on the test server for a short while. Work on this is continuing of course.
- **QoL:** We are also focused on bringing QoL features/changes, such as in-game teleportation cards to other islands, faster crafting times for 2nd jobs, EXP adjustments and more!
- **New textures:** Our in-house artist has started to work on new textures in order to replace some of the more outdated ones currently in the game.
- **Localization updates:** Updates to localization to enhance and fix existing translation. 

The list goes on and on, these are just some of the things we are currently conceptionalizing and working on. We will of course keep you updated on the progress as and when there are news.

Best,

Your Florensia Team

notes.title: Status Update
notes.content:
Hello,

As you may know (see previous News) we took over Florensia. We just wanted to give over a small update about the take over process.

In general, we will talk more about upcoming content, etc.  when we are into the code and all tools, but here are some process details:

We got most of the necessary stuff from AHA so far

We have to rebuild several things as they are completely outdated. For example, we need to find a solution to make patches in a way that it can be done on more as on one PC. They use for patches timestamps of a PC. If we start using different PCs (like from different coders), the patching process will fail because of that…

This means we have to rebuild certain tools and processes as we expected.

We need all the crazy old 3ds Max plugins to work, but we will get there.

Our new coder is already investigating the coding side, and we will start with simple things first. He has already found the reason during a first code check why you can not click/walk to certain areas on maps. The reason is that the area was flagged as a Water region.

So, step by step, we will get closer to a workable situation for us.

notes.title: Florensia Patchnotes 09.05.2022
notes.content:
We have deactivated the double drop event. The double EXP event will stay online until 16.05.2022.
Today's short maintenance also introduces some minor changes to drop chances. You can find those changes listed below:

In order to reduce the recipe drop spam, we have reduced the following drop chances:
- Grade 1 guild stone
- Life of the Marsh recipe
- Life's wounds recipe
- Butterfly of Oblivion recipe

We have also increased the drop chances for following items:
- Eye of Hexion
- Draug Brenin's Sign
- High Purity Parasitic Stone 

Due to the unpredictability of the drops, we kept the changes to a minimum. Because of that, we will keep monitoring them as well as community feedback and make changes where needed. This means that none of those changes introduced with today's patch are set in stone.

notes.title: Florensia Patchnotes 07.04.2022
notes.content:
Dear Florensians,

We released a small patch to fix an issue with the damage calculation of combat pets. More precisely, they do not ignore defense values of monsters and players anymore. This was especially obvious when using skills.

As of this patch, skills will now be affected by magical defense from both monsters and players, meaning they inflict less damage with skills the more magical defense there is. Auto attacks on the other hand are now influenced by physical defense, meaning it has an equal effect as the magical defense.

On another note, we will have a short maintenance on Friday the 08.04.2022 at 7:00am CEST to activate a double… double double event? We will be activating two events 👀

We hope you enjoy this update and are eager for your feedback as always.

Stay safe everyone and have fun!

We are also tweaking a lot of the previously changed skills to balance them where needed.

A key aspect of what we are trying to do with this patch is bring more dimensions into the skills.
What we mean by that is that we are trying to make skills useful by adding secondary effects to them, rather than just increasing their main attributes such as damage, duration etc.
Please understand that this is highly experimental and we don't know the outcome of that yet. However, if the tests succeed, expect to see more of those updates in the future.

notes.title: Tips for your online security
notes.content:
Dear Florensians,

In the past few days, we had an increased number of reports from people with suspicious activities on their accounts. [b]We want to first and foremost inform you, that no data from GiikuGames has been compromised.[/b] This means that none of the data has been leaked or distributed. 

However, many people use the same username, password and email combination on multiple online services, including Florensia. This means that if any of those services get compromised, it also poses a risk for any other account. Due to this, we would ask everyone to take their time and rethink their passwords, especially if they are over 2 years old. There are many ways on how you can make your life on the internet more secure, changing your passwords regularly is one of those measurements.

Here is how you can update your Florensia password:
[olist]
[*] Go to [url=https://www.florensia-online.com/en]https://www.florensia-online.com/en[/url]
[*] Login to your Florensia ccount on the official website.
[*] Got to “view account” -> “View Account”.
[*] Click the “Edit” button and change your password.
[/olist]
Having a secure password is at least as important as changing it regularly. Below you can find some resources on how to make your Internet life more secure:
[list]
[*] How to make a secure password (EN): [url=https://bit.ly/3uamX6G]https://bit.ly/3uamX6G[/url]
[*] How to make a secure password: (DE): [url=https://bit.ly/3t5g84M]https://bit.ly/3t5g84M[/url]

[/list]
We want to again emphasize that none of our Florensia data was compromised, this is merely a friendly reminder from our side, so that everyone can enjoy their time the most. We are always working to ensure the highest standards of safety and we will keep working on it, to ensure that all your data stays secure.

Fair winds and following seas,
Your Florensia Team

notes.content:
Dear Florensians

With the third class balanced patch, we aimed for one of the most important aspects of every class: buffs. Our goal was the same as always: Create a system in which all skills are a viable option to use, albeit under different circumstances and for different builds.

With todays patch, the double EXP event has been activated on top of the already existing Tower event.

[h3][b]Skill and Status Reset[/b][/h3]
Also with this patch, you will be granted another free skill reset. Note that if you already had a free skill reset from last time, you will not get a second one.
We've also thrown in a Status Reset, as we now changed a lot of skills with our last three patches.


[h3][b]Class Changes[/b][/h3]
[b]Noble[/b]
Sword of Spirit is one of the first skills you learn and forget about instantly since it's totally useless for magic classes - no Noble needs melee damage. We therefore changed it to give magic min and max attack, but at a lower rate than Magic Power (which only grants maximum magic attack).

Magic Boost is a great skill to boost the MP of fellow players, but for the amount of points you have to spend, it could be better. So we increased the amount of MP on each level.

Recharge in theory is a great skill to help your teammates get out a skill they desperately need to. But it just did not give enough mana to be worth it. It was also weird that you had to sacrifice less MP than you can recharge. To fix this, we increased the scaling and adjusted the mp costs accordingly.

[*] DURATION [u]5m[/u] ⇒ 20m

[/list]

notes.title: Florensia patchnotes 29.01.2021
notes.content:
Der Florensians,

Todays patch removes the Christmas decoration as well as the double drop event and simultaneously brings back the tower event. However, there is something else that has been changed with this patch.

As some of you might be aware, there is currently a bug that allows players to duplicate items. While this issue only affects a small group of players, it is those players that have openly showed us their very ill intention to cause harm to Florensia and its community.

As we’ve mentioned many times before: We will eventually get all of them. However, it is an extremely tedious and time-consuming task. [b]This is why we have decided, to temporarily close the bank.[/b] 

This means that currently, you will only be able to retrieve items from the bank but unable to insert any. This is – for now, the intended behavior. 

We have been working on solving this issue for the past months but this is unfortunately not a case of Florensias code being old, but rather an issue of old programs running on new hardware. I will spare you the details here and just say that we are close to implementing a solution, but require a bit more time to get it right. 

We are fully aware of the implications that this brings and we want to apologize for the inconveniences that are caused by this update. We are however forced to act now, before the situation gets out of hand. 

We are of course working fulltime and with our best efforts to solving this issue as quickly as possible and will keep you updated on the situation, as soon as we have any news.

Stay tuned, as we have a few gifts for you that we will share later!

notes.title: [EVENT] Florensia Birthday
notes.content:
Dear Florensians,

We have successfully left 2020 behind us. At this point we would like to take the opportunity to thank each and every one of you for your active participation in our events and your feedback. We have some big plans this year and start with the birthday event that accompanies Florensia every year. 

On 23.01.2015 Florensia opened its doors for curious and adventurous people. This day, we want to celebrate together with you! Therefore we have three events for you. Baking a Florensia birthday cake, self-created videos and a specially created drawing on the theme of Florensia.

[b]The great baking:[/b]
The Florensia team is looking for the most beautiful and delicious cakes that our adventurers can bake. Create a unique cake or pie. Our event team has many sweet tooths who will analyze your recipes and pictures. In order for us to know how you baked your cake, we ask you to include a recipe of the cake (if you don't want to share it, please contact us via Discord).
Happy baking, we are looking forward to your creations!

[b]Your adventures in Florensia:[/b]
It has been 6 years since Florensia opened its doors again. We have experienced a lot together. Moments of love, of excitement, of adventures and also of fights. Grab your friends and record a video. The theme is "A day with my friends, in Florensia". Videos that consist of screenshots or contain screenshots are just as welcome, but the video cannot consist of just one screenshot. Also, a video without images, that is, consisting only of images and sound, will not be accepted.

The video should last at least one minute and at most five minutes (slight deviations are of course allowed). When submitting, feel free to use a YouTube link (if you don't want your video to be seen, please set it to private and then send us the link).

[b]The big drawing:[/b]
As you know, we love drawings as much as you do. That's why we are looking forward to your drawings. The drawings should have Florensia and birthday specific content (e.g. a wurn or a dodo with a party hat) and are welcome both on paper and digitally.

[b]Submissions / Rules:[/b]
[list]
[*] Please send the pictures or videos to [DE] Namica or [DE] Ferrox via Discord or via Insta / Facebook as DM to the responsible person there. Please add your account name
[*] Please note that we can only accept submissions that fulfill these requirements
[*] Note that 50% of the content you send in (if it contains Florensia content) belongs to you. The other 50% belongs to Giiku-Games and AHA. We may post your submissions on Instagram, Discord, Facebook, or our website. By participating in the events, you explicitly agree to this. (If we want to use your creations for other press and/or public legal things, we will of course consult with you).
[*] We reserve the right not to evaluate content if we determine that little or no work has been put into the submission.
[*] Music that is under copyright is prohibited. Content that contains such music will not be accepted. Music that is included in Florensia is allowed. You can find it in the Florensia folder under Data and then on Sound. Music that you have created yourself, you can of course use.
[*] Everyone is welcome to participate once in each event to increase the chance of winning. However, a person can only win once in all events. (For example, if player 1 likes to bake and draw, he can submit both a cake and a drawing. Both looked wonderful, but he only won first place in baking).
[*] Stolen, discriminatory, racist, sexual or fake entries, will not be accepted.
[/list]
[b]Deadlines:[/b]
[list]
[*] Please send us pictures of your baking creations, the videos, your drawings, your FanArts or all together, by Monday, 14/02/2021 at 00:00 CET (UTC +1).
[*] (Please note that for organizational reasons we cannot accept any submissions after the deadline).
[/list]

[b]Prizes:[/b]
Of course, you can expect great prizes! These prizes will be given out for every single event, but they are server-spanning.
[list]
[*] 1st place: 30.000 AP
[*] 2nd place: 15.000 AP
[*] 3rd place: 10.000 AP
[*] 4th and 5th place: 5.000 AP
[*] 6th place - 50th place: Surprise package (EXP Pots and other useful items)
[/list]

We wish you a lot of fun and success in designing your creations and are looking forward to your submissions. If you have any questions or uncertainties regarding this event, please feel free to contact any member of the event team via Discord! - Concluding; Happy Birthday!!!

Your Florensia team

Some of you may remember that on the ocassion of Florensia's fifth birthday we offered all guilds to celebrate their birthday with a private guild spawn. 
However, it seems that this has been forgotten, so we would like to remind you of this now. But there will be some changes regarding the guild spawns.

Feedback regarding some issues
Over the time, we have received a lot of feedback regarding problems. From this feedback we could conclude that many guilds had the problem of not knowing when their guilds birthday is.

You don't have to look for an exact date in this registration period. The exact dates for the individual events will be made in the course of the half year.

notes.title: Essence Update - Maintenance
notes.content:
Dear Florensians,

After more than 2 years of development, we are excited to present you the biggest update Florensia has ever had: [b]The Essence System[/b]. Todays 24.06.2020 maintenance will introduce the Essence System to the live servers for everyone to enjoy. 
The servers will be taken offline at 6:00am Central Europe Time (CET). We have no ETA on when the patch will be done but we expect a long maintenance, so please bare with us!

[h2][b]What is the Essence System?[/b][/h2] The Essence System marks a fundamental change to the equipment system in Florensia. Previously, we had the Fusion System which would allow you to upgrade your gear with bonus stats that would last for 24 hours. While this sounded great in theory, it never worked the way it was intended to and we felt that Florensia was not benefitting from such a system. 
Therefore, we started working on a new concept that would allow the players to customize their playstyle like never before and at the same time provide late game content - which Florensia was lacking.

Now, after more than 2 years of development we are finally ready to release the Essence System and we hope that you are going to love it as much as we do!


[h2][b]What new content does the Essence System provide and how does it work?[/b][/h2]
Along with the Essence System, there are over 260 new Essence items and 280 recipes for you to craft! 
Each piece of equipment, from your armor to your weapons can now be extended to have up to 4 Item Slots. There are two different types of item slots: [b]Normal slots[/b] and [b]Core Slots[/b], latter of which are marked by having a golden border. The only difference between normal slots and the Core Slots are that the Core Slots can hold Purple Essences, which represent the highest tier of Essences as well as some other rare ones that cannot be equipped in normal slots.

To get started with Essences, simply go to any of the lords on the respective islands and click the new "[b]Item Slot[/b]" button. In there, you will find everything that you need to extend your gear (create the slots) to unlocking them and even removing Essences from slots, should you wish to do so. 
Once you have the slots unlocked, head over to your skill window, switch to the [b]Action[/b] tab and in the category Basic Actions you will find a new action called [b]Essence Management.[/b] 
Once clicked, it will open a window in which you can equip your items that have unlocked slots with Essences. 

For more details, visit our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC3JpiLQ8M9C90kCwZTnzOTQ]YouTube channel[/url], where we have videos that explain the entire Essence System in detail.


[h2][b]Your feedback matters![/b][/h2]
We're happy to hear all kinds of feedback you have regarding the new system. To do so, join our Discord Server: [url=https://discord.gg/giikugames]discord.gg/giikugames[/url]

We thank you all for your patience and wish you fun with the update!

Your Florensia Staff

notes.title: [ANNOUNCEMENT] Test phase for new regulations
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/e6b78f6dd67d8cca37a5b4b0cf3946c697537cb0.png[/img]

Dear Florensians,

Starting today, the 12th of July 2019, something will change for you, and also for us:

We are working on making the game more enjoyable and natural for you. In the past, certain play options were restricted by rules, which meant that the game had a framework of rules, but problems between players weren't resolved among themselves. As a result, many small battles were fought with the support team. We have received a lot of feedback on this, especially recently. We've discussed it and came to the conclusion that we would like to change this situation, together with you.

As of today, a period of rule reduction concerning game mechanics will begin. This means, for example, that monsters can be hunted together and mobtrain is allowed, as long as this does not happen at respawn points. The period of rule reduction is currently planned to last two weeks.

Nevertheless, we would like to give you some basic rules that will continue to exist:

• Behave as you would expect your teammates to behave. Fairness and netiquette are what everyone should strive for.

• Do not exploit any errors (to your advantage). Everyone should have the same chances!

• Do not use third-party programs that manipulate, modify, or nullify Florensia, clients, game aspects, or game features.

• Don't try to rob fellow players of their fun in the game! So-called griefplay would speak against the first point!

Note: The terms and conditions you agreed to with your registration will continue to exist.

If you have any questions regarding this phase, you can always contact our support via Discord (www.discord.gg/giikugames), the ticket system (DE: hilfe@florensia-online.com | EN: help@florensia-online.com) or directly in the game (Game Masters are recognizable by the red font and the [Ber/Lux] tag in front of the character name).

Your Florensia Team

[h1]Rules for the event: [/h1]
· The fighting group is not allowed to cross the blue lines on the map. 
· Spectators have to sit outside of the zone. 
· Players are not allowed to respawn once they’re dead. 
· However, a saint is allowed to revive them. 
· While fighting, players are allowed to change they equipment like dresses. 
· Fighting Pets are not allowed. 
· CashShop Buffitems (like +%Dmg stones, 75% HP Pots) are not allowed. 
· However, pots make from the alchemist profession are allowed. 
· Fusions are allowed. 
· Buffs are only allowed from your party members (Buff from the lord is also not allowed). 
· After a player lost connection, he is allowed to continue fighting. 

If a player breaks one of the rules, he and his group is fully disqualified. 

How to judge someone has won: 
· If there are groups that were able to defeat all bosses, the group with the lowest needed time wins. 
· If more than one group run out of time at the same boss, the winner is determined by the left HP amount of the boss.

Dear Florensians,

We fixed the following issues in our maintenance today:

- Mounts/riding pets bugfixes
- We have fixed the problem that players could unmount you from your pet, while buffing you. Now you will stay on your mount and get the buffs from other players too!
- We have fixed the problem, that after calling the mount, you could not interact with NPCs or cast skills. Please note, it is not meant to fight on your mount, when you cast a skill or are hit by a monster or player in PvP areas, then your mount will be automatically disabled. So, if somebody attacks you, this system makes a lot of sense, to respond in a fast way to the attacker.

- Combat pet visible bugfix

We have fixed the issue with combat pets, that the correct level and experience were not shown when they were in sealed state after being over level 99. There was no problem with experience or level of the pets, it was only a visible problem inside the mouseover information window. So, the correct levels and exp will be shown in shops again (if somebody wants to sell a combat pet higher than level 99, too).

- Map problem bugfix

We have fixed a bug with the map pulldown-menu. It was possible to click on empty map entries there, showing wrong maps (because these should not appear on these islands). Now there are no empty entries anymore the map pulldown menu is working correctly.

- 2-hands and shield

It was once again possible to exchange items in your inventory to visually wear a 2-hand weapon together with a shield. This was fixed today and we hope that this was the final fix for that kind of issue.

- Sound issues

We are currently working on sound bugfixes, to get a nicer playing experience with Florensia, especially if you’re playing with headphones.

We supplied the first part of the bugfix today and fixed the broken waterfall loop sound, the one which you could hear very loudly on the Rainbow Island, near Rainbow Basin Altar of Memory Safe point. Now there is a really nice environment sound again.

More bugfixes incoming soon! Have fun playing!

Your Florensia Team

Dear Florensians,

We have heard legends of him…that Black Wizard that seeks to destroy the land and all who come near him. The Wizard with such incredible power, only the bravest dare speak his name. His army is gathering for the attack, and it seems all might be lost…

But, what adventurers would our Florensians be if they weren’t prepared to face such danger? We know you are all ready for the fight, but we can’t let you go unequipped! You should have a weapon suitable for such a dangerous journey! We welcome all of you to the fray and will equip you with weapons forged with metals from the darkest corners of the world by the most talented of our smiths.

Today we would like to give you a hint of what it is to wield such a weapon. First, we shall speak to all Explorers, Mercenaries and Saints! Have you ever dreamed of a sword that makes your enemy shiver with fright? A weapon, so great its pure power is engraved in mysterious blue etchings in its surface? Your Florensia Team

notes.title: [UPDATE] A Scavenger's Tale - Part II
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/6d3ec4b5cf5433db9ff5b07b72dc239d4805c8c6.png[/img]

Dear Florensians,

As you know, a wise bard recently uncovered an ancient tale on his journey through Florensia. He spoke of a dark evil, a terrible magic that no one had dared wield until now. If you believe his words, a young magician made a pact with a demon to gain unimaginable power. It is said that his heart is filled with hate and his only goal is to destroy Florensia once and for all. Furthermore, he will not stop until the deed is done. How could Florensia stand against such evil?

After hearing this chilling tale, the adventurers searched for the bard to ask for more information. They were desperate for anything that might help them fight against the magician and his terrible army that they had been told about.

They finally found him in a nearby tavern. The bard listened to their requests and, leaning heavily on his wooden staff, he answered slowly:

"It is said, that for every spell cast nature seeks a balance. To cast a spell so dark and terrible that it could destroy all of Florensia, the magician will have no choice but to create certain anchor points. These will draw the magic focus and connect to cause pure destruction. Everyone who has learned the magical arts knows this. For the release of such a large amount of dark energy, nature will also create light in the darkness, and so bring balance to the world. I cannot tell you for sure what will happen. When it comes to magic, nothing is ever certain. But I am positive the light will give you a way to defeat evil. An adventurer brave enough to stand against such evil will find a way to fight. Of course, he will have to enter the magician's realm and no one knows where that may be...so I cannot deny I am worried. But the only chance we have is you."

Your Florensia Team

notes.title: [UPDATE] A Scavenger's Tale - Part I
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/6d3ec4b5cf5433db9ff5b07b72dc239d4805c8c6.png[/img]

Dear Florensians,

A long-forgotten tale has recently come to light. It was passed down through the generations and told in hushed voices, for fear it could be overheard, since it is a dark and mysterious tale indeed.

Now it came to pass that a wise bard passed through Florensia. He claimed to have extremely important news. One night, many curious adventurer gathered around a bonfire so the bard could tell them of this ancient tale, for he was one of the few who knew about it. He lowered his voice and spoke in a hushed whisper:

"Once there was a dark wizard who was feared everywhere. He was the descendant of an ancient clan that did not want to bow before the laws of Florensia. This brought about a war between the magicians and the humans which resulted in the magicians being wiped out, since they were not powerful enough to face Florensia's army of skilled warriors. Peace returned and everything seemed well.

However, hidden in the shadows, one boy survived, with magical abilities of his own. The rage and grief of losing his family enhanced his powers and he vowed to one day take revenge on the humans who had destroyed his clan. Legend has it that he entered a pact with a demon to gain forbidden black magic. His soul was consumed by the dark force of the demon and fed with anger. The mage resurrected his own hateful army from the bare ground which had remained of his country after the war.

Now he will stop at nothing to destroy Florensia and its inhabitants once and for all."

After the bard had finished his chilling tale, the adventurers looked at each other across the bonfire in sudden fear. Which of them would dare stand against such pure evil?

Your Florensia Team

Dear players,

You probably noticed that we have been dropping hints here and there about a large Florensia update. Well, brave explorers, we are going to give you some more details about it today!

We proudly present our Scavengers of the Past Update! This update will dive straight into the world of Florensia and give it a huge amount of new content for all of you to explore! The adventure never stops and we hope you are ready for it!

Here are the things that await you in

SCAVENGERS OF THE PAST:


- First of all, the max. level will be raised to level 105!

- There will be new weapon and armour equipment!

- Fierce new monsters will be sent into battle!

- New quests will be waiting for those of you brave enough to seek them!

- A new boss will rise, guarding great loot!

- And, finally, we will introduce a completely NEW MAP!


More creatures and equipment, a new environment and new paths for our Florensians to tread! All of this is coming up 
Keep your eyes peeled for more detailed information in the following weeks before the release!

notes.title: [EVENT] Design Your Dress
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/21345e60802e37ea30dfeeee16bc47e56f769c4d.png[/img]

Dear Florensians,

You have always dreamed of actively shaping Florensia and seeing your ideas come to life? Take your chance now and take part in our Design Your Dress competition!

Be inspired by your favourite costumes or create a completely new look that we have never seen before! Wedding Gowns, Royal Costumes, Sinister Dark Outfits, Cute Animal Dresses or Shiny Armour...it's completely up to you! We can't wait to see what you come up with!

After the contest deadline, your designs will be posted for the community to vote on. The design with the most votes from the community will be used as a template to make a new costume for Florensia and will be available in our item shop! This is the opportunity for you to have explorers all across Florensia wear your design!

There are some details about your submission that are important:

- Only one submission per person is permitted

- The submission must be your own design

- Send us your designs with a picture size of at least 1200x720px

- Your Design should include a back and front view.

- Your e-mail size shouldn't be more than 16MB

- Please send us your sketch to flocontest@gamesinflames.com

- The deadline is the 30th of April 2017

We are very excited to see what inspirational ideas our amazing Florensia community will come up with! Have fun!

Your Florensia Team

notes.title: [UPDATE] Avery Elite Dungeon
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/cb461a5c5b6d3bcca305c84d268bc539c7a822e9.png[/img]

Dear Florensians,

It is time - The Avery Elite Dungeon is coming in February! Yes, you heard correctly! We have a unique dungeon with many new quest NPCs, mighty elite monsters and epic bosses coming and cannot wait to see how all you brave adventurers venture out into this new and unknown territory! Be prepared for fights that will test your limits and challenge your guilds to give it everything they've got!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kqAjB3F4rQM

Do you dare to approach the guard at the entrance to the dungeon and begin your journey? Only the bravest of adventurers may enter!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/9ff4b73187056ca1ac3500fe2bccd8c5dc1cf708.jpg[/img]

Encounter many new quest NPCs!! Some are friendly, but others may not be as nice as they seem...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/763934b93a7853603e3e1af13df271f7912a0549.jpg[/img]

You will meet well-known bosses in their Elite-form! There is no joking around with them or you might lose your head!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/c843dc903dd92392ec50dfa9bbec02a5391fe707.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/7c6642217ee61a477d20a77e92cc5922105e3c0d.jpg[/img]

And if you survive the Elite Bosses...well, then you will experience the true might of Dungeon Boss Elite Vampire Lord Robinson!!!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/f6e6eafd00583fc9c51a3ab8e17a454bfe1c1a1e.jpg[/img]

3. Go to the Language tab
4. Select the language you wish to use from the drop-down menu
5. Click OK
